name: abl-mcp-server
description: A model-agnostic MCP server for governed ABL and loan-tape analytics.

scripts.build:platform: pnpm --filter @abl/platform-contracts build && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-bff build && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-console build
scripts.check:platform: pnpm --filter @abl/platform-contracts build && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-contracts check && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-bff check && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-console check
scripts.test:platform: pnpm --filter @abl/platform-contracts build && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-contracts test && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-bff test && pnpm --filter @abl/platform-console test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:platform
scripts.verify:platform: pnpm run check:platform && pnpm run test:platform && pnpm run build:platform
